_note: Curated daily / weekly / recurring tasks. requirements are checked live against the account (skills + prerequisite quests) so get_dailies can show only what the player can currently do. Times are rough.

dailies.name: Battlestaves from Zaff
dailies.what: Buy discounted battlestaves from Zaff in Varrock (more per day with Varrock diaries).

dailies.name: Herb boxes (NMZ)
dailies.what: Buy up to 15 herb boxes/day with Nightmare Zone points; open for grimy herbs.
dailies.note: Requires NMZ access (several boss quests) and reward points.

dailies.name: Buckets of sand
dailies.what: Collect 84 free buckets of sand from Bert (after speaking to him the day before).

dailies.name: Managing Miscellania
dailies.what: Refresh your approval rating and top up the coffer so your subjects keep gathering resources.
dailies.note: Royal Trouble raises the coffer cap and yield.

dailies.name: Herb farm run
dailies.what: Harvest + replant all herb patches (~80 min growth cycle).
dailies.note: Call get_farm_run for live patch states, kit and per-patch routes.

dailies.name: Tree / fruit-tree run
dailies.what: Plant tree + fruit-tree patches; best passive Farming XP in the game.

dailies.name: Bird house run
dailies.what: Re-bait the 4 Fossil Island bird houses (~50 min cycle) for passive Hunter XP + seeds.

dailies.name: Tears of Guthix
dailies.what: Weekly minigame granting XP in your lowest (or a chosen low) skill.
dailies.where: Tears of Guthix cave, Lumbridge Swamp
dailies.value: free XP in your worst skill
